SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'CONTAINER' AS object_type, c.id AS resource_id, c.warehouse_id, c.plate_no, NULL AS trailer_no, c.container_no, NULL AS vehicle_source, c.container_status AS current_status, CASE WHEN c.dock_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DOCK' WHEN c.yard_position_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'YARD' ELSE 'WAITING' END AS current_area, COALESCE( c.dock_code, CONVERT(p.dock_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci, CONVERT(z.zone_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci, '等待区' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci ) AS area_label, c.arrived_time AS gate_in_time, CASE WHEN c.arrived_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, c.arrived_time, NOW()) ELSE NULL END AS stay_minutes, c.related_order_no, NULL AS related_task_id, c.driver_name, c.driver_phone, c.exception_flag, c.exception_reason FROM yms_container_resource c LEFT JOIN yard_dock p ON c.yard_position_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN yard_zone z ON c.yard_zone_id = z.id AND z.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.container_status NOT IN ('LEFT_YARD', 'RETURNED', 'EXPECTED_ARRIVAL')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TRAILER' AS object_type, t.id AS resource_id, t.warehouse_id, t.plate_no, t.trailer_no, NULL AS container_no, t.vehicle_source, t.trailer_status AS current_status, CASE WHEN t.dock_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DOCK' WHEN t.yard_position_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'YARD' ELSE 'WAITING' END AS current_area, COALESCE( t.dock_code, CONVERT(p.dock_code USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci, CONVERT(z.zone_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci, '等待区' COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci ) AS area_label, t.arrive_time AS gate_in_time, CASE WHEN t.arrive_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.arrive_time, NOW()) ELSE NULL END AS stay_minutes, t.related_order_no, t.related_loading_task_id AS related_task_id, t.driver_name, t.driver_phone, t.exception_flag, t.exception_reason FROM yms_trailer_resource t LEFT JOIN yard_dock p ON t.yard_position_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN yard_zone z ON t.yard_zone_id = z.id AND z.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.trailer_status NOT IN ('LEFT_YARD', 'EXPECTED_ARRIVAL') ) yard WHERE yard.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND ( yard.plate_no = #{keyword} OR yard.container_no = #{keyword} OR yard.trailer_no = #{keyword} OR yard.plate_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR yard.container_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR yard.trailer_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY yard.gate_in_time DESC LIMIT 10
